Commentary.Commentary: Ben Stokes was the pick of the bowlers as the all-rounder finished with a 5-fer. Adil Rashid finished with four wickets too but mainly due to some loose shots by India. So England have a tough task ahead here. First have to wipe off the deficit and then post a big total. Let's see how do they reply. TEA HAS BEEN TAKEN TOO!

Pretty good batting effort by India to get a handy lead of 134 runs. They were under pressure at one stage when England removed Kohli and the score was 204 for six. After that Ashwin and Jadeja shared a crucial partnership and then Jayant Yadav joined in to extend the lead. Earlier Pujara and Kohli hit fifties each and got out as England bowled well yesterday.

Appeal for an LBW! Flighted outside off, turning in, Umesh Yadav tries to play but gets hit on the pads. There is a big appeal for a leg before but the umpire says not out. Replays show the ball would have missed the leg stump.
That's dug in short and Stokes misses the target. Going down the leg straight to the keeper.

The pitch hasn't offered anything at all and the English bowlers have been rather ineffective. They haven't hit the right areas and when they have, haven't done so consistently enough. Stokes was the only one to scalp a wicket but even he, including others, has been poor. India will look to bat on as much as possible and probably counter-attack post-lunch. Remains to be seen how it unfolds. Join us in a short while for the second session.

A good session for India. They've managed to score 83 runs in the session for the loss of just one wicket. Ravichandran Ashwin was the only one to depart and that too was a soft dismissal in hindsight. But Jadeja continued the good work and along with Jayant Yadav, stitched an unbeaten 53-run partnership to give the home side a lead of 71 runs.
Full and attacking the stumps, Jayant Yadav pushes it back to the bowler. THAT WILL BE LUNCH ON DAY 3!
Tossed up outside off and it's turning away, left alone for the keeper to collect.
Yadav taps this in front of point and looks at Jadeja for the single. The southpaw isn't interested though.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Rashid gives this some good air and loops it around off, driven to mid off for nothing.
Jayant Yadav stays perfectly behind the line of the delivery and keeps it out.
Jayant plays with the spin and turns it to the leg side for a single.
Tossed up on the stumps, it's driven towards mid on.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Bowls this on a length, outside off, defended off the back foot.
Loopy and fullish around off, Jadeja gets across to defend this but gets it off the inner half towards mid-wicket. A single is taken.
Slow turn and this allows Jadeja to go back and punch it away on the off side. Wants the single but Bairstow is quick on his toes and stops the batsmen from taking the run.
Comes from over the wicket and floats it up around off, a bit of away turn and it's left alone.

The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

First signs of spin in the day. A loud shout for an lbw but it's correctly turned down. It's going down leg though so the umpire decides not to pay attention to the appeal.
50-run stand between Jadeja and Jayant!
Another flatter ball, Jayant pushes it out towards covers and takes a brisk single.
Flatter and going down leg, Jayant looks to go after it but misses.
Bowls this slower through the air and tosses it up around off, Jadeja sees the ball carefully and shoulders his arms to it.
Floated on off, Jadeja comes ahead and defends.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Yadav drives this fuller ball back down towards mid on.
Fuller ball on middle and leg, blocked.
Drifting in on middle and leg, it's worked to the leg side off the inner half for a single.
Flighted delivery from Adil Rashid, around off, pushed towards mid off.
Bowls this a little flatter and maintains a stump-to-stump line, Jayant once again brings out a solid defensive shot.
Similar ball, same result.
Loopy and full on middle and off, Jayant Yadav comes ahead and presents a tight defensive shot.
Full on middle and leg, driven down to mid on.
Rashid tosses it up outside off, Jadeja strides across and keeps it out on the off side.
Floats this one up on the stumps, it's defended off the front foot.
Shorter, flatter and keeps a little low as well, Jayant Yadav goes back and does well to bring his bat down in time to block.
Fullish and attacking the stumps, Jayant Yadav dead-bats this into the track. Does so rather comfortably.
Full, flatter and much straighter from Batty, it's kept out off the front foot and onto the track ahead.
On middle and leg, flicked to short mid-wicket.
Some drift on that as Batty tosses it up outside off, Jadeja pushes it towards the covers for a brisk single.
Gareth Batty is into the attacking now, replacing Ben Stokes.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
A back foot punch presented by the batsman as he hits it towards mid on.
Leg bye! On leg, it goes off Jadeja's pads as he tries to flick it away. A leg bye is taken.
Extremely full on off, Yadav opens his body up a bit and drills it square on the off side for one run.
Floats this one up on the stumps, it's driven to the mid on fielder. No run this time.

FIVE OVERTHROWS! Very full on off, Jadeja drills it to mid off and takes the man on there. Jake Ball is the fielder and he has a shy at the bowler's end. He misses and there's nobody backing up. The ball races away to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Banged in short by Stokes, it's angling in on the body, Jadeja does well to rise, get on top of the bounce and fend it away on the leg side for a quick single.
Outside off, left alone.
Full and aimed at the base of off stump, RJ brings his bat ahead of his pad and defends it with the full face of the bat.
Good length ball outside off, Jadeja shoulders his arms to that one.
Back of a length outside off, Jadeja mistimes the cut towards point. No run taken.
Back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot on the off side.
Full outside off, driven to covers to end the over.
Gives this some decent flight and bowls it on a fuller length, kept out off the front foot.

Shout for a leg before but there's no way that's going to ever be given out. It pitched outside leg and it was probably going down leg as well. Jayant Yadav went back to play at it but missed. No harm done.
A bit flatter, turning away on off, a solid front foot defense presented by the batsman.
Full and attacking the stumps, Jadeja eases it down to long on for a single.
Too full as it's tossed up outside off, Jayant drives it through to deep cover for a single.

The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
A touch fullish in length, quite tight from Ben as it's blocked off the front foot.
Bouncer from Ben Stokes, it's ducked and evaded.
Another one well outside off, this is on a fuller length but the result is the same. Left alone.
Angles across a length ball way outside off, left alone.
Rashid tosses it up once more, on middle and off, Jayant Yadav prods forward and meets it with a straight blade.
Looped up on the stumps, it's driven back down the ground for no run.
Flatter and turning away from around off, kept out off the back foot.
Short and flat on the stumps, Jayant Yadav rocks onto his back foot quickly and muscles the pull over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Floats this one up just around off, it's turning just a little bit, Yadav comes ahead and blocks it out.
Slider on middle and leg, Jayant goes back and punches it back down to mid on.
Back of a length on off, Ravindra off his back foot punches it to the right of the bowler.
Stokes has a change of angle and comes from over the wicket, angles across a length ball which is not bothered with once more.
Well outside off once more, left alone.
WIDE! Another one way outside, another wide signalled. Poor from Stokes.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
WIDE! It's way, way outside off, it even goes across the wide line. Hence, the umpire raises his arms and signals a wide.
Length ball in the channel outside off, left alone once again.
Spears this full and very wide outside off, Jadeja has nothing to do with that.
Full on the stumps, it's driven back down to long on for a run.
Short and flat outside off, Yadav with a back foot punch gets it through the gap in the covers for a single.
Full and loopy outside off, driven to the cover fielder. No run taken.
Turning away from outside off, on a fuller length, it's left alone.
Tossed up on the stumps, it's worked to mid-wicket for one.
Drags the length back on this, Jadeja walks across and defends it out.
Angling in on the pads, it's worked towards short leg where Duckett does well to stop the ball from going past him.
Works this straighter delivery to the mid-wicket region for a brisk single.
Bumper pounded in hard, at 138 kph, Ravindra Jadeja has nothing to do with that.
FOUR! Length ball on middle and off, Jadeja off his back foot punches it back down the ground. Gets another boundary to his name.
Jadeja dabs this length ball towards point and sets off for a single. Beats the direct hit at the non-striker's end and completes the run.
From around the wicket, Jadeja hangs back and punches it through the covers for a single.
Jayant Yadav presents another solid front foot defensive shot and ends the over.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
It's turning away from around off, played to point for nothing.
3rd Test fifty for Ravindra Jadeja!
Fifty up for Jadeja. And he celebrates with a ninja-like, like he swinging the nunchucks in his hands. He tucks it through square leg for a single and reaches the milestone.
Tossed up leg breaker around off, Jadeja plants his front foot forward and drives it back in the direction of the bowler.
Looped up outside off, driven through to deep cover for a single.
Adil Rashid is into the attack now.
Sprays this on the hips, glanced down towards fine leg for a single.
Short of a length delivery outside off, Jayant Yadav rises and keeps it down rather comfortably on the off side.
Angling in from over the wicket on middle and leg, tucked to the leg side. Dot ball.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Length delivery angling in on middle and leg, it's whipped through the square leg region for a single.
A short ball outside off, Jayant punches it through the covers. Jos Buttler gives it a good chase and manages to pull it back in. Three runs taken.
Drinks break!
Stays right behind the line and blocks it out. Nicely done by Jadeja.
Straying on the pads, it's clipped through towards deep backward square leg for an easy run.

FOUR! A bit of Ashwin in that. Stand and deliver stuff. Back of a length outside off, Jayant Yadav camps back and punches it through cover-point. Sends it all the way once more and he picks up his second boundary of the over.
Another rock solid defense from Jayant Yadav. He stands his ground, presents the full face of the bat and taps it in front of the cover region.
Stays right behind the line of this length delivery and keeps it out solidly.

FOUR! That's an excellent shot. Overpitched on the off pole, Jayant with a beautiful straight bat, leans into the shot and drives it back past mid on. No chance left for the chasing fielder as the ball wins the race.

Close one. It's angling in on middle, gets Jayant Yadav to open up a bit. He's a bit squared up as the ball takes the outside edge and runs down to third man. One run added to the scoreboard. India now lead by 21 runs.
Outside off, on a good length, Jayant Yadav with a watchful leave.
A short mid-wicket comes in place.
Speared in full and angled in on middle and off, worked to the leg side.
Very good from Ben Stokes. Back of a length outside off, maybe the slightest hints of straightening up, Jayant Yadav looks to fend it away but the ball just whiskers past the outside edge.
Pounded in hard and it's angling down leg, left alone by the batsman.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Full and fired in just outside off, goes off the inside edge and past the leg pole as Jadeja tries to put bat on ball. A single is taken as the ball rolls down towards fine leg.
On the fuller side once more, it's flicked to the mid-wicket region.
Back of a length on the stumps, Jadeja from deep within the crease punches it back down the track.
Tad fuller outside off, Ravindra Jadeja drives it through the covers but won't get any run for it.
On a length, this time Jadeja camps back and defends it off the back foot on the off side.
Fuller length ball angling in from around off, Jadeja stays behind the line, brings his bat ahead and defends it rather solidly.
Length ball just around off, Jayant Yadav keeps it out off the front foot and ends a successful over by Stokes.
Jayant Yadav is the next man in.

OUT! The bowling change works and it's played out according to plan. All that protection in the off side has worked its magic. Fuller length delivery outside off, Ravichandran Ashwin leans across and drives it uppishly square on the off side. It's straight towards Buttler at backward point who dives low to his left and takes a good catch. Ashwin's gritty yet superb knock has come to an end.
Outside off, driven straight to short cover.
Some nice carry here for Stokes, he bowls this on a length outside off, quite harmless though and Ashwin is going to have nothing to do with that.
On a good length once more, outside off, Ashwin plays this a bit away from his body and plays it on front of covers.
Good length delivery outside off, some nice shape on that, it's left alone.
Ben Stokes comes into the bowling attack.
Jadeja is firm in defense as he keeps this back of a length ball out off the back foot and that will be the end of the over.
It's full in length, Jadeja is drawn forward and he keeps it out with bat and pad together.
In the corridor of uncertainty, Jadeja initially thinks of playing this inside the line but at the last moment, decides to pull out of it.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

On a length and aiming the top of off stump, it's played back in the direction of the bowler. Anderson throws it back at the stumps as Jadeja brings his bat ahead to put it away. A similar incident had happened yesterday between Vijay and Anderson, where Anderson had thrown the ball and Vijay hadn't moved. It wasn't referred upstairs though.
Anderson with a length delivery angling in from outside off, Jadeja with a solid, straight bat blocks it square on the off side.
FOUR! That's as graceful and as elegant a shot as you'll see. Ravi Ash lunges forward, opens his body up a bit and drives it ever so well through the gap in covers. Ends the over with a boundary.
Shortens the length on this and bowls in on off stump, Ravichandran Ashwin rises and taps it down on the track ahead.
Fuller in length outside off, driven to the cover region.
FOUR! Beautiful shot. Fullish in length and outside off, Ashwin leans into the drive and creams it through cover-point. No chance of anybody stopping that as the ball races away to the boundary line.
Jadeja works this towards the mid-wicket region and picks up a single for doing so.
Shorter and pounded in hard, it's down the leg side as it's left alone.
Length ball outside off from over the wicket, it's punched wide of the mid off fielder.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.

Anderson bowls a cutter on this occasion and pitches it outside off, Jadeja gets a healthy edge as he reaches across to push at it. It doesn't carry to the slip fielder though, probably because of the lack of pace.
This is angled in on middle stump, flicked to the mid-wicket region for no run.
Length ball in the channel outside off, it's not bothered with.
Continues from around the wicket and angles in a length ball to the southpaw, he stays behind the line and blocks it out.
Takes the pace off it and bowls a slower delivery, Ravichandran Ashwin gets a faint edge on it as he leans ahead to push it away. It however falls well short of Jonny Bairstow behind the stumps.
Stays deep within his crease and defends it out off the back foot.

Loud shout for an lbw but there's a big inside edge. Woakes angles in a length delivery from around off, Ashwin strides forward and gets a big inside edge before it raps him on the pads. There's an appeal for a leg before but it's correctly turned down.
Back of a length outside off, Ravi Ashwin hangs back and pushes it away on the off side with a straight bat.
Length ball outside off, shaping away a touch, it's punched towards cover-point for nothing as it's straight to the fielder.
Pitched slightly ahead of a length and outside off, worked through the square leg region for one run.

Fuller length ball coming in on middle and leg, flicked a bit uppishly towards mid-wicket. Beatty is the man there and he dives to his right to try and stop it. It goes off his fingertips and a single is taken.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Ravindra Jadeja is rock solid in defense as he positions himself perfectly behind the line of this length delivery.
A bit harmless as it's well outside off, the southpaw has nothing to do with that one.
Another length delivery angled in from outside off, Ravindra Jadeja comes forward and blocks.
Anderson instantly starts off from around the wicket angles in a length ball from around off, Jadeja stays behind the line and keeps it out with a straight bat.
James Anderson is brought into the attack now.
Comes from wide of the crease and angles it on middle stump, it's kept out from within the crease towards silly mid on.
Fires this full and wide outside off, a lot of pace on that as Woakes bowls this at 144 kph, Ashwin goes after it and looks to drive it square but misses.
A bit fuller in length, Ashwin uppishly works it towards mid-wicket. Bit risky, had there been a short leg in place it could have been caught.
Woakes brings out the short one and bangs it in hard, Ashwin does well to drop his arms and lets it go through for the keeper.
Silly mid on is in place now...
Pitches it up there this time, on middle and leg, Jadeja flicks it with the wrists and gets it through square leg for one.
Good length ball outside off, Ravichandran Ashwin off his back foot punches it through the point region for a single.

FOUR! He's connected it this time and got the result he wanted. It's a bit full and there's some flight on it, Jadeja lofts this nicely over the mid off fielder for a boundary. India now lead by 4 runs.
Full ball on middle and off, Jadeja drills it back towards mid off.
Yorker on middle and off, Jadeja backs away a bit and drills it back to the bowler.
Flatter and shorter outside off, Ashwin gets back and cuts it square towards deep point for an easy single.
Fullish in length and pitched outside off, pushed towards wide mid off.
Flatter and straighter outside off, it's played back to the bowler off the leading edge.
Keeps it a bit on the shorter side, Jadeja rises and taps it down to the right of the bowler.
On a good length, well outside off, Ravindra looks to push it tamely from inside the line but is beaten past his outside edge.
Short of a length well outside off, no shot offered to that one by the southpaw.
Shortish and banged in hard, Chris hits the deck hard here, Jadeja rises and manages to keep it down on the track.
Good length delivery angled across the left-hander by Woakes, it's left alone for the keeper to collect.

FOUR! That's a very good shot! Back of a length delivery angled across, Ravindra Jadeja stands firm and punches it firmly through cover-point. Gets the timing on that perfectly and sends it all the way beating the chasing fielders.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full on middle and leg, it's worked towards mid on. No run taken.
A bit on the flatter trajectory, outside off, Ashwin is drawn forward as he blocks it out back down the track.
Full ball attacking the stumps, it's eased down to long on for a comfortable single.
Drifting in on middle and off, it's worked gently on the on side for nothing.
Bowls it extremely full, almost a yorker really, Jadeja does well to dig it out on the off side.

Fuller length delivery just around off, Jadeja comes forward and gets an inside edge past the leg stump as he attempts to block. A run taken to end the over.
Too straight from Chris Woakes, bowls it on middle and leg as Ravi Ashwin clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Sprays this way down the leg side, the batsman looks to go after it but misses.
It's pitched just back of a length and straightening up a touch after hitting the deck, Ravichandran Ashwin stays back and keeps it out on the off side.
Length delivery outside off, Ashwin opens the face of the bat and taps it in front of point.
FOUR! Woakes with a freebie to start things off with, he angles it on the pads as Ashwin flicks this away. Gets it through the gap in the square leg region and picks up a boundary for it.

We are all set to get things started as the players and the umpires have made their way out in the middle. It will be the overnight batsmen, Ravichandran Ashwin and Ravindra Jadeja, to continue with the bat. They will attempt to take India to a lead of somewhere around the 100 mark. Chris Woakes will be taking the ball first up. Let's roll...

PITCH REPORT - Sunil Gavaskar doing the pitch report says that there are certain areas on the pitch which are slowly opening up due to the soil loosening a bit. Batting last will be difficult. However, it is still a good track to bat on.
WEATHER - Another chilly morning in Mohali. Should get better for the players as the day goes on.

It was a day of momentum changes as India wrestled back the initiative towards the end after England's heroic fight. Having bowled out the visitors quickly in the first hour, one would have expected the hosts to take advantage but the tourists fought hard, taking 6 Indian wickets before the duo of Ashwin and Jadeja stood firm. They have added 67 for the 7th wicket and have brought the deficit to a bare minimum. The plan for the home side would be to bat for as long as possible, ideally till Lunch at least. Will they be able to achieve that? Or will the tourists swing the momentum again? Hello and a warm welcome to the third day's play of the third Test between India and England in Mohali.
... DAY 3, SESSION 1 ...

India trail by just 12 runs and will want to bat as long as possible. With the pitch expected to turn more as the game goes on, any substantial lead here will be handy and it sets up for a cracking day tomorrow. Do join us at 0930 IST for all the action from Day 3. Until then, it's goodbye and take care!

Poor Karun Nair was sold down the river by the Indian skipper who followed him soon. England would have thought of running through the line-up but out came Ashwin and Jadeja. They stitched an unbeaten 67-run stand to save India from falling apart. Both of them have played their shots and Ashwin in particular has looked at real ease to score yet another fifty.

Been an entertaining day of Test cricket! Plenty of runs were scored and as many as 8 wickets fell today. India wrapped up the England innings early bowling them out for 283. India then began superbly with them being 148 for 2 at one stage. But after Tea, India lost a flurry of wickets. Pujara and Kohli both scored a fifty each but could not convert those into big knocks and allowed England to come back in the game.
Angles it on off, Jadeja covers the line and answers it with a straight bat. THAT IS STUMPS ON DAY 2!
Strays it on the pads, Jadeja looks to flick but misses as the ball brushes his pads towards the right of Bairstow.
Gets behind the line and defends it towards the left of the bowler.
RJ punches it back to Anderson.
On a length and outside off, Jadeja defends it down.
Back of a length ball on middle, Ashwin pulls it in front of square for a single. He is really struggling out there.
Length ball down the leg side, Ravindra leaves it alone.
Bangs in short on leg, Jadeja lets it go.
Fuller and curling in, Jadeja looks to flick but gets it off the inner part of the bat towards mid-wicket.
Good length ball on off, punched back to the bowler.
Jadeja pushes it towards covers.
Short of a length ball, angling in, Ashwin fends it past short leg for a single.

FOUR! Ah... this is beauty of a shot! The great Sachin Ramesh Tendulkar will be proud of it. Straight drives, it makes me feel so good when a batsman essays it! Ashwin stands there and admires the shot, posing for the photographers? He should be!
9th Test fifty for Ravichandran Ashwin!

FOUR! FIFTY! Scorching! Fuller in length and outside off, width on offer as well. Ashwin leans into it and caresses it through covers. In the last over we saw Jadeja getting the timing behind the shot and this time it's Ash!
Fuller in length on middle, driven down to mid on.
JAMES ANDERSON comes back for a final spell today.

Jadeja defends it off the back foot.
50-run stand between Jadeja and Ashwin!
FOUR! Not a soul moved! Back of a length ball outside off, Jadeja stays put in the crease and slams it through covers for a satisfying boundary. Delightful stroke that!
Back of a length ball on off, punched straight to mid off.
On a length and outside off, glided past gully for a single.
Fuller on the pads, flicked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Chris Woakes to bowl with the second new cherry.

Full outside off, Ashwin prods forward and drives it square of the wicket on the off side for a single.
Tossed up outside off, pushed towards covers.
Full and around off, defended by making a good stride forward.

Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Almost a return catch! Googly around off, Jadeja looks to drive but ends up chipping it back to Rashid and is lucky as the ball just about dips in front of the leggie before he collected it.

SIX! He's picked the bones out of that one! Floated ball around off, Jadeja is in some mood here. Once again clears the front leg and wallops it over long on for a maximum. That's huge and even Kohli stands up in the dressing room to applaud.
On middle and leg, worked towards the leg side.
Outside off, turning in, Jadeja camps back and cuts it behind point for a couple.

Loopy ball around off, driven straight to Moeen at mid off.
Loopy ball around middle and off, driven down to long on for a single.
Floated ball around off, defended into the ground.
Full on middle, bunted back to Batty.
Jadeja gets back and tucks it towards short leg.
Fuller around middle, flicked towards short leg.
GARETH BATTY to bowl now.
Ravichandran rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Short and stays low outside off, Jadeja camps back and crunches it through covers. He wanted another one as well but Ashwin is struggling and so they have to settle for a single.
Fuller around off, driven back to the bowler.
Floated ball around off, Ashwin drives it towards Cook at mid off and scampers across for a single.
Loopy around off, driven towards covers.
Tossed up ball around middle and leg, worked towards short mid-wicket. Shouts of CATCH but no damage done.
ADIL RASHID to bowl now.
Fuller on off, Jadeja presses forward and pushes it towards down the track.

Defended off the front foot nicely.
Fuller on middle and leg, worked through the leg side for a single.

RA has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Floated ball around off, Ashwin stays forward and defends.
Tossed up ball around off, pushed back to Moeen.
Around off, turning in, Ashwin covers the line and defends.
Anderson fires it full on the base of the off stump, Jadeja comes forward and blocks.
Fuller in length on off, RJ defends it from within the crease.
Angles away on a length outside off, Jadeja is happy to leave it alone.
Length ball outside off, Ash looks to cut but gets a bottom edge through first slip for a single.
Fuller in length and outside off, Ashwin leaves it alone.

Fuller and angling in, Jadeja gets across and drives it towards mid on.

James Anderson is back on!

Fuller around middle, worked off the front foot toward short leg.

Flatter ball outside off, punched off the back foot towards covers for a single.
Tossed up ball around off, Ashwin defends it off the front foot.
DRINKS BREAK!

Shorter outside off, pushed through covers for a single.

Good length on off, Kohli gets across and tucks it towards mid-wicket from his crease.

Ashwin stays back and defends this one from his crease.

Pushes it towards covers from his crease.
Back of a length on off, Kohli defends it from his crease.
Kohli comes forward and defends it.

OUT! Brilliance from Buttler! On a length outside off, Kohli pushes it towards backward point and calls Karun through for a single. He sends him back but Buttler fires a direct hit at the non-striker's end. England are confident and it is referred upstairs. England are confident of a run out at the non-striker's end. Karun Nair is the man in question.

Rashid gets Rahane lbw who goes for the review.
Floated outside off, Rahane comes forward and defends it.

DAY 2... SESSION 3...

88/1 in the 29 overs bowled in the afternoon session. A good one for India. They lost the wicket of Parthiv Patel in the first hour who played a fluent knock in his comeback Test match. But since then, it has been tough going for the Englishmen. They tried hard but failed to break the partnership between Pujara and Kohli which is worth 75 runs at the moment. The catch dropped by Bairstow off Pujara didn't help their cause either. The deficit is now down to 135 and England will need a few wickets in the last session to get back on equal terms in this match. Do join us in a short while.
